/**
 * Get information about the build (generated by the CI)
 */
#Const Version "2.1.2"
#Const ScriptName "Libs/Nadeo/CMGame/Utils/BuildInfo@2.Script.txt"

// ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ //
// MARK: Libraries
// ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ //
#Include "TextLib" as TL
#Include "Libs/Nadeo/CMGame/Utils/Context.Script.txt" as Context
#Include "Libs/Nadeo/CMGame/Utils/Http@3.Script.txt" as Http
#Include "Libs/Nadeo/CMGame/Utils/Platform.Script.txt" as Platform

// ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ //
// MARK: Structures
// ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ //
#Struct K_TitleInfo {
	Text Commit;
	Text Date;
	Text Version;
	Text TitleUpdate;
}
#Struct K_UserInfo {
	Text AccountId;
	Text Login;
	Text Name;
}
#Struct K_PlatformInfo {
	CSystemPlatform::ESystemPlatform Name;
	CSystemPlatform::ESystemSkuIdentifier Sku;
	Text Family;
	Integer FirstParty;
	Text ExeVersion;
}
#Struct K_BuildInfo {
	K_TitleInfo TitleInfo;
	K_UserInfo UserInfo;
	K_PlatformInfo PlatformInfo;
}

#Struct Http::K_Request as K_Request

// ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ //
// MARK: Constants
// ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ //
#Const C_TitleInfoFilePath "file://Media/BuildInfo.json"
#Const C_Event_RequestBuildInfoUpdate "CMGameUtilsBuildInfo_Update"
#Const C_DefaultConfigDirtyCounter 1

#Const C_TitleInfo_Null K_TitleInfo {
	Commit = "",
	Date = "",
	Version = "",
	TitleUpdate = ""
}
#Const C_UserInfo_Null K_UserInfo {
	AccountId = "",
	Login = "",
	Name = ""
}
#Const C_PlatformInfo_Null K_PlatformInfo {
	Name = CSystemPlatform::ESystemPlatform::None,
	Sku = CSystemPlatform::ESystemSkuIdentifier::Unknown,
	Family = "",
	FirstParty = 0,
	ExeVersion = ""
}
#Const C_BuildInfo_Null K_BuildInfo {
	TitleInfo = K_TitleInfo {
		Commit = "",
		Date = "",
		Version = "",
		TitleUpdate = ""
	},
	UserInfo = K_UserInfo {
		AccountId = "",
		Login = "",
		Name = ""
	},
	PlatformInfo = K_PlatformInfo {
		Name = CSystemPlatform::ESystemPlatform::None,
		Sku = CSystemPlatform::ESystemSkuIdentifier::Unknown,
		Family = "",
		FirstParty = 0,
		ExeVersion = ""
	}
}

// ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ //
/// Set the user info
Void SetUserInfo(CSystemPlatform _System, K_UserInfo _UserInfo) {
	declare K_BuildInfo CMGame_BuildInfo2_BuildInfo for _System = C_BuildInfo_Null;
	declare Integer CMGame_BuildInfo2_ConfigDirtyCounter for _System = C_DefaultConfigDirtyCounter;
	CMGame_BuildInfo2_BuildInfo.UserInfo = _UserInfo;
	CMGame_BuildInfo2_ConfigDirtyCounter += 1;
}

// ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ //
/// Update the user info with the data of the given user
Void UpdateUserInfo(CSystemPlatform _System, CUser _User) {
	if (_User == Null) {
		SetUserInfo(_System, C_UserInfo_Null);
	} else {
		SetUserInfo(_System, K_UserInfo {
			AccountId = _User.WebServicesUserId,
			Login = _User.Login,
			Name = _User.Name
		});
	}
}

// ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ //
/// Set the platform info
Void SetPlatformInfo(CSystemPlatform _System, K_PlatformInfo _PlatformInfo) {
	declare K_BuildInfo CMGame_BuildInfo2_BuildInfo for _System = C_BuildInfo_Null;
	declare Integer CMGame_BuildInfo2_ConfigDirtyCounter for _System = C_DefaultConfigDirtyCounter;
	CMGame_BuildInfo2_BuildInfo.PlatformInfo = _PlatformInfo;
	CMGame_BuildInfo2_ConfigDirtyCounter += 1;
}

// ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ //
/// Update the platform info with the data of the given system
Void UpdatePlatformInfo(CSystemPlatform _System) {
	if (_System != Null) {
		SetPlatformInfo(_System, K_PlatformInfo {
			Name = Platform::GetPlatform(_System),
			Sku = _System.SkuIdentifier,
			Family = Platform::GetFamilyName(Platform::GetFamily(_System)),
			FirstParty = Platform::GetFirstParty(_System),
			ExeVersion = _System.ExeVersion
		});
	}
}

// ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ //
/// Set the title info
Void SetTitleInfo(CSystemPlatform _System, K_TitleInfo _TitleInfo) {
	declare K_BuildInfo CMGame_BuildInfo2_BuildInfo for _System = C_BuildInfo_Null;
	declare Integer CMGame_BuildInfo2_ConfigDirtyCounter for _System = C_DefaultConfigDirtyCounter;
	CMGame_BuildInfo2_BuildInfo.TitleInfo = _TitleInfo;
	CMGame_BuildInfo2_ConfigDirtyCounter += 1;
}

// ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ //
/// Load the title info file
K_Request StartLoadTitleInfoFile(CNod _Context, Text _FileUrl) {
	return Http::CreateGet(_Context, _FileUrl);
}
K_Request StartLoadTitleInfoFile(CNod _Context) {
	return StartLoadTitleInfoFile(_Context, C_TitleInfoFilePath);
}
Boolean IsLoadingTitleInfoFile(CNod _Context, K_Request _RequestTitleInfo) {
	return Http::IsProcessing(Http::Update(_Context, _RequestTitleInfo));
}
Void StopLoadTitleInfoFile(CNod _Context, K_Request _RequestTitleInfo) {
	declare K_Request RequestTitleInfo = Http::Update(_Context, _RequestTitleInfo);
	if (Http::IsSuccess(RequestTitleInfo)) {
		declare Text Result = TL::Trim(Http::GetResult(RequestTitleInfo));
		if (
			TL::Length(Result) >= 2 &&
			TL::StartsWith("{", Result) &&
			TL::EndsWith("}", Result)
		) {
			declare K_TitleInfo TitleInfo = C_TitleInfo_Null;
			TitleInfo.fromjson(Result);
			SetTitleInfo(Context::GetSystem(_Context), TitleInfo);
		}
	}
	Http::Destroy(_Context, RequestTitleInfo);
}

// ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ //
/// Get the build info
K_BuildInfo GetBuildInfo(CSystemPlatform _System) {
	declare K_BuildInfo CMGame_BuildInfo2_BuildInfo for _System = C_BuildInfo_Null;
	return CMGame_BuildInfo2_BuildInfo;
}

// ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ //
/// Get the value of the build info dirty counter
Integer GetDirtyCounter(CSystemPlatform _System) {
	declare Integer CMGame_BuildInfo2_ConfigDirtyCounter for _System = C_DefaultConfigDirtyCounter;
	return CMGame_BuildInfo2_ConfigDirtyCounter;
}

// ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ //
/// Format the build info into a short line of text
Text FormatBuildInfo_Short(K_BuildInfo _BuildInfo) {
	declare Text Result;

	if (_BuildInfo.TitleInfo.TitleUpdate != "") {
		if (Result != "") Result ^= "-";
		Result ^= _BuildInfo.TitleInfo.TitleUpdate;
	}
	if (_BuildInfo.TitleInfo.Version != "") {
		if (Result != "") Result ^= "-";
		declare Text[] Matches = TL::RegexMatch("\\d{4}(\\d{8})", _BuildInfo.TitleInfo.Version, "");
		if (Matches.count == 2) {
			Result ^= "t"^Matches[1];
		} else {
			Result ^= "t"^_BuildInfo.TitleInfo.Version;
		}
	}
	if (_BuildInfo.PlatformInfo.ExeVersion != "") {
		if (Result != "") Result ^= "-";
		declare Text[] Matches = TL::RegexMatch("\\d{4}-(\\d{2})-(\\d{2})_(\\d{2})_(\\d{2})", _BuildInfo.PlatformInfo.ExeVersion, "");
		if (Matches.count == 5) {
			Result ^= "e"^Matches[1]^Matches[2]^Matches[3]^Matches[4];
		} else {
			Result ^= "e"^_BuildInfo.PlatformInfo.ExeVersion;
		}
	}

	return Result;
}

// ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ //
/// Format the build info for the clipboard text
Text FormatBuildInfo_Clipboard(K_BuildInfo _BuildInfo) {
	return
"""
BuildInfo
=========

TitleInfo
---------

* Commit: {{{dump(_BuildInfo.TitleInfo.Commit)}}}
* Date: {{{dump(_BuildInfo.TitleInfo.Date)}}}
* Version: {{{dump(_BuildInfo.TitleInfo.Version)}}}
* TitleUpdate: {{{dump(_BuildInfo.TitleInfo.TitleUpdate)}}}

UserInfo
--------

* AccountId: {{{dump(_BuildInfo.UserInfo.AccountId)}}}
* Login: {{{dump(_BuildInfo.UserInfo.Login)}}}
* Name: {{{dump(_BuildInfo.UserInfo.Name)}}}

PlatformInfo
------------

* Name: {{{dump(_BuildInfo.PlatformInfo.Name)}}}
* Sku: {{{dump(_BuildInfo.PlatformInfo.Sku)}}}
* Family: {{{dump(_BuildInfo.PlatformInfo.Family)}}}
* FirstParty: {{{dump(_BuildInfo.PlatformInfo.FirstParty)}}}
* ExeVersion: {{{dump(_BuildInfo.PlatformInfo.ExeVersion)}}}
""";
}
